correctness.rationale: For every fixed r>0 and |x|→∞ *in the specified strong-memory quasistatic mixture*, substitute u=e^{-t}. Variance polynomial v(u)=S-Au+B u² has maximum S=(2r+1)/r at u=0 and strictly negative derivative throughout 0<u<1; the endpoint variance defect is linear, so Watson lemma with exponent u^(r-1) yields the exact C|x|^(-2r) Gaussian correction, not a pure Gaussian equivalent. Expansion 1/(2v)-1/(2S)=cu+du² with c=A/(2S²), d=A²/(2S³)-B/(2S²) and amplitude correction A/(2S) gives relative coefficient −(2r+1)^3/[2(r+1)] at x^(-2). Tail integration yields 2CS x^(-(2r+1))exp(−x²/(2S)), and iid extreme value scaling yields Gumbel with squared centering log N−(r+1/2)log log N+log B. Independently checked the symbolic coefficient and mpmath endpoint integrals for r=0.5,1,2 at x=40; ratios 1.0000102,1.0000321,1.0001817 to two-term asymptotic. Original verification source inspected. Domain excludes any claim about finite bath-memory tails, uniformity in r, or dependent sampled trajectories.
